(3) The accounts of the Corporation shall be examined

13.
The seal of the Corporation shall not be affixed to
any  instrument  whatsoever  except  in  the  presence  of
Chairman  of  the  Corporation  and  one  member  of  the
Corporation and one member of the Board of Directors such
number of person as may be provided for in the rules in force
for the time being of the Corporation, who shall sign their
names to the instrument in token of their presence and such
signing shall be independent of signing  of any person as a
witness.

14.
Nothing  in  this  Act  contained  shall  prejudice  or
affect  the  rights  of  the  Republic  or  of  anybody  politic,  or
corporate  or  of  any  other  persons  except  such  as  are
mentioned in this Act and those claiming by, from or under
them.

15.
In  the  event  of  any  inconsistency  between  the
Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall
prevail.
